notReady.title: Not ready to supervise yet
notReady.description: {{title}} isn't confirmed by {{expert}} yet. Finish its debrief and teach-back first, so Socrates only guides with knowledge the expert confirmed.

errors.lookupFailed: Sorry, I couldn't look that up ({{message}}).

graph.sharingStopped: Screen sharing stopped. Socrates can't see your work until you share again.
graph.startWorking: Start working. Your progress shows up here.

voice.disconnected: Socrates' voice disconnected. Type your questions below, or turn voice back on.
voice.notSetUp: Voice isn't set up for supervised runs (npm run setup:agents -- supervisor). Type your questions below.

mentor.intro: How {{expert}} does it, step by step, in their own words.

start.title: Run this workflow with Socrates standing by
start.description: Share the window you'll work in (e.g. the mock ERP, on Training cases). Socrates stays quiet: ask whenever you need help, and it steps in only if you're about to make a mistake {{expert}} would have caught.

leaveGuard.title: End this supervised run?
leaveGuard.description: Socrates is still standing by. If you leave now, screen sharing stops and Socrates can't help with the rest of this run.

chatPanel.emptyBody: Work as you normally would. Ask anything, out loud or below, and Socrates answers in {{expert}}'s words. If you're about to make a mistake {{expert}} would have caught, it'll tell you.
chatPanel.thinking: Socrates is looking at your screen…
